nodes.label: Eth1 Data Pending Finalization

nodes.label: Deposit Index Condition Met

nodes.label: Both Finalization Conditions Met

nodes.description: Remove unnecessary Merkle hashes from finalized portion of tree

ambiguities.text: The term 'finalized' is used for both checkpoint finalization and deposit finalization with different meanings
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Distinguish between 'checkpoint finalization' (Casper FFG finality) and 'deposit finalization' (both eth1_data and deposit_index conditions met). Use 'deposit finalization' when referring to pruning eligibility.

ambiguities.text: Variable-length hashes (maximum size DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_DEPTH) - exact pruning rules not fully specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume finalized hashes are retained at each level where they are needed, and unnecessary intermediate hashes are pruned once descendants are finalized.

ambiguities.text: No specification of how to handle snapshot requests when tree state is in flux during finalization
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume snapshot generation should use a consistent view of the tree at a finalized point, not an in-progress state.

implicit_assumptions.description: Clients will not bootstrap with an invalid weak subjectivity checkpoint
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Invalid checkpoint could lead to accepting fraudulent deposit snapshots, enabling fake validator deposits

implicit_assumptions.description: The peer providing the deposit snapshot is honest and provides authentic data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious snapshot could cause syncing node to reject valid future deposits or accept invalid tree state

implicit_assumptions.description: Deposit contract events are correctly indexed and available for tree reconstruction
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing deposit events could cause tree reconstruction failures or Merkle proof generation errors

implicit_assumptions.description: Finalization conditions will eventually be met for all deposits under normal operation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Perpetually unfinalized deposits would prevent tree pruning, causing unbounded storage growth
